name: capability-workbench
description: Artifact-first agent capability engineering for skills, plugins, guidance, and trigger contracts: frame behavior gaps, evaluate baselines and candidates, author validated changes, govern portfolios, and activate explicitly. Use Agent Harness for runtime and harness-level evaluation.

interface.shortDescription: Engineer reliable agent skills, plugins, and guidance.
interface.longDescription: Capability Workbench is the artifact authoring and governance plane of agent capability engineering. It turns desired behavior, observed gaps, and trusted sources into reusable skills, plugins, agent guidance, trigger contracts, and coherent portfolios. It covers discovery, synthesis, portfolio architecture, authoring, behavioral evaluation against a baseline, audit, reality repair, safety vetting, packaging, and explicit activation. Agent Harness owns runtime design, operation, orchestration, and harness-level evaluation. Artifacts remain on the validated source surface unless the user explicitly requests installed or global use.
capabilities: Capability synthesis from public repositories, marketplaces, research sources, community implementations, and local references
Whole-portfolio and cross-plugin architecture review for split, merge, delete, move, router, shared capability, reference extraction, and script extraction decisions
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Cursor rule guidance authoring
Imagegen-backed bitmap plugin icon prompts, asset checks, and manifest wiring
Skill name and description trigger metadata design
Cross-runtime model-visible skill catalog, overflow, and body-loading comparison
Exact item-by-dimension evidence coverage gates for aggregate audit claims
Provider-neutral behavioral evaluation of candidate capability artifacts against a baseline
Reality repair for stale or false skill, script, plugin, and MCP contracts
Global agent skill installation with safety vetting
Agent marketplace plugin creation and global visibility validation
defaultPrompt: Use Capability Workbench to turn an observed agent behavior gap into the right validated skill, plugin, guidance, trigger, evaluation, or portfolio change.
Use Capability Workbench to perform broad external-first discovery and synthesize a well-vetted agent skill or plugin on the selected source surface, activating it only when requested.

Use Capability Workbench to audit a skill/plugin portfolio across plugins and decide whether capabilities should be kept, split, merged, moved, deleted, routed, moved to references, extracted into shared mechanics, or extracted into scripts.
Use Capability Workbench to create, refresh, audit, or migrate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Cursor rule files for coding agents.
Use Capability Workbench to design or debug skill names and descriptions so the host agent loads the right SKILL.md.
Use Capability Workbench to compare how Codex, Claude-family snapshots, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, OpenCode, and Qwen Code expose skill catalogs and load selected bodies.
Use Capability Workbench to validate a broad audit claim against an exact declared item-by-dimension evidence matrix.
Use Capability Workbench to compare a candidate skill, plugin, or guidance change against a baseline with realistic cases, deterministic assertions, repeated trials, and an adoption decision.
Use Capability Workbench to repair a stale skill, script, plugin, or MCP contract that contradicted live behavior during work.
Use Capability Workbench to generate a coherent imagegen-backed icon for a new marketplace-backed plugin and wire it into the plugin manifest.
Use Capability Workbench to validate and install an agent marketplace plugin so it is visible globally in the host agent.
